name: Vampire’s Factory
summary:
🩸 Welcome to Vampire’s Factory – Where One Mistake Could Be Your Last! 🦇
You've just been hired at the most unusual blood distribution factory in the world. Your job is simple: sort the blood containers correctly as they pass through the conveyor belt. But there’s a catch…

⚠️ Do NOT trust the labels! The only thing that matters is the color of the sign. Make a mistake, and your boss might take more than just your paycheck...

💀 Can you survive the job?
